beats.headline: Broadcom Jumps 6.21% on Google and Anthropic AI Chip Deals
beats.explanation: Broadcom shares climbed 6.21% to $333.97 on heavy trading volume following the announcement of multi-year AI supply contracts with Alphabet's Google and AI startup Anthropic. The rally was largely company-specific, as competitor AMD was up just 0.61% and supplier TSM added 1.04%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Rises 4.19% on Expanded Meta AI Accelerator Deal
beats.explanation: Broadcom gained 4.19% to reach $396.72 after Meta Platforms announced an expanded custom AI chip partnership running through 2029 for custom MTIA silicon and networking hardware. The advance outpaced peers, with competitor INTC up 1.77% and supplier TSM falling 1.26%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Rises 5.52% on Wells Fargo Price Target Hike
beats.explanation: Shares rose 5.52% to $439.79 after Wells Fargo raised its price target from $430 to $545, citing higher-than-expected data center AI power demand and semiconductor revenue. Connected peers also moved higher, including supplier TSM gaining 4.48% and competitor NVDA advancing 4.39%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Rises 4.73% Pre-Earnings While Chip Peers Drop
beats.explanation: Broadcom increased 4.73% to $446.77 on 1.6x average trading volume amid strong investor interest ahead of its upcoming earnings release. The advance was company-specific, as competitor AMD dropped 0.38%, competitor INTC fell 5.14%, and supplier TSM dropped 1.51%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Rallies 4.70% to Record High Before Q2 Earnings
beats.explanation: Shares reached an all-time closing high of $481.57, advancing 4.70% as investors continued to build positions ahead of fiscal Q2 earnings and news that Anthropic confidentially filed to go public. Gains were shared with competitor QCOM, up 5.17%, and supplier TSM, up 2.54%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Plunges 12.59% on Flat AI Revenue Guidance
beats.explanation: Broadcom shares sank 12.59% to $418.91 on 3.1x average volume following its earnings release, driven by disappointment over flat forward AI guidance and concerns regarding AI gross margins. While competitor AMD also dropped 3.56%, the severity was specific to Broadcom as competitor NVDA rose 1.82% and supplier TSM gained 1.89%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Rebounds 4.30% After JPMorgan Recommends Buying
beats.explanation: Broadcom gained 4.30% to close at $392.90 after JPMorgan advised investors to be aggressive buyers following the recent pullback, noting that Google's 2nm TPU roadmap remains intact. The upward move was mostly company-specific, though competitor INTC rose 3.46% and competitor NVDA fell 1.33%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Drops 4.67% Amid Valuation and Cloud Rumors
beats.explanation: Shares slipped 4.67% to $392.13 as reports highlighted market caution around customer relationships, including Google rumors and rich valuation metrics following Q2 earnings. The drop was isolated from competitors AMD and INTC, which advanced 2.65% and 5.19% respectively.

beats.headline: Broadcom Falls 3.06% in Broad AI Chip Sector Selloff
beats.explanation: Broadcom dropped 3.06% to $380.15 on news that SK Hynix would slow high-bandwidth memory expansion, creating concerns across the broader AI hardware complex. The decline was shared across the sector, with competitor QCOM falling 8.01%, competitor AMD dropping 5.76%, and supplier TSM down 6.69%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Adds 4.83% on $30B Extended Apple Deal
beats.explanation: Shares rose 4.83% to $388.69 after Apple announced a multi-year manufacturing and supply agreement valued at over $30 billion through 2031, including a $1.5 billion expansion of Broadcom's Colorado facility. The gain was company-specific, outpacing competitor AMD at 0.25% and competitor INTC at -0.14%.

beats.headline: Broadcom Slides 5.94% on AI Debt Financing Concerns
beats.explanation: Broadcom fell 5.94% to $392.99 after Bank of America raised concerns about AI financing vehicles potentially requiring up to $370 billion in senior debt by 2029, alongside an SEC filing showing Third Point exited its position. Broadcom diverged sharply from competitor AMD, which surged 6.50% on the day.

beats.headline: Broadcom Falls 4.61% Amid Google Deal with Marvell
beats.explanation: Broadcom retreated 4.61% to $362.48 as rival Marvell secured a sizable AI chip agreement with Google, raising competitive threats in custom silicon workloads. The weakness was also shared by competitor INTC, which fell 4.02%, and competitor AMD, which dropped 3.71%.

arc: Between April and August 2026, Broadcom experienced dramatic price swings driven by the immense scale and evolving risks of the custom AI silicon market. The stock initially marched from $314.43 in early April to an all-time high of $481.57 in June, propelled by monumental hyperscaler commitments—including multi-year AI accelerator agreements with Google, Anthropic, and Meta Platforms. However, the stock sharply reversed when fiscal Q2 earnings revealed flat forward AI revenue projections and margin headwinds, sparking a 12.59% single-day selloff. Although a $30 billion long-term supply extension with Apple provided a temporary catalyst in July, subsequent investor anxiety emerged over the massive debt financing required to build out multi-gigawatt AI infrastructure and mounting competition from Marvell on Google's custom chip contracts. By late August, Broadcom settled down to $362.48, demonstrating how hyperscaler custom chip dependency carries high valuation sensitivity whenever future spending growth shows signs of moderation.
